verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of in-product AI is a marketing claim that Fieldwork's AI agents collect, validate, and package compliance evidence after you describe a control. That is a narrow form of task delegation to built-in agents. The MCP/OAuth docs describe connecting external assistants, which is adjacent and not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of a general-purpose built-in assistant, detail on what tasks can be delegated and how, product docs beyond a single marketing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
